description: anvilml-testui: System panel — three endpoint handlers
context: Replace System panel stub in index.html: #sys-info-btn ('Get Hardware Info'), #sys-env-btn ('Get Env Report'), #sys-versions-btn ('Get Versions'), #sys-response (pre). In app.js PANEL:SYSTEM: handleSysInfo()->apiFetch('/v1/system'), handleSysEnv()->apiFetch('/v1/system/env'), handleSysVersions()->apiFetch('/v1/system/versions'); all call showResponse('sys-response',data,ok). Wire three buttons in INIT under '// System panel' comment. node --check app.js exits 0. Manual: all three buttons return JSON from a running AnvilML.

description: anvilml-testui: Models panel — list, get, rescan handlers
